subject: Clarify deployment cost tradeoffs and commit options
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Suarez <ana@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Clarify deployment cost tradeoffs and commit options

Ana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks I promised to follow up on.

Recap:
- Primary goal: embed high-volume summarization and search across internal docs (near real-time).
- Target latency: 250–400ms p95 for single-turn generation; occasional longer jobs for nightly batch rerank.
- Expected steady-state: ~25M tokens/day, with spiky peaks up to ~60M/day during business hours.
- Data residency: US-only; possible private VPC requirement for regulated subsets.
- Timeline: pilot in 2–4 weeks, procurement decision Q1.

Asks / next steps I need from you to size options:
1) Confirm whether the pilot needs VPC (customer-managed) or if a hosted trial is acceptable.
2) Expected pilot length (2 vs 4 weeks) and token cap for a hosted pilot.
3) Any hard constraints on payment / PO terms (net30, net45, or need vendor setup).
4) Who on your infra/security side should I include for a VPC/network diagram review?

What I’ll send next: a short spreadsheet with two modeled scenarios (hosted per-token estimate vs reserved Dedicated capacity commits) and an outline of one-time VPC setup fees and timelines. I’ll also include our SOC2 summary and a sample SOW for a 2-week pilot.

If it helps, I can recommend a low-friction hosted pilot configuration that covers the 25M tokens/day baseline for quick benchmarking, or a small Dedicated pool option optimized for the 400ms p95 SLO.

Proposed contact for procurement: I’ll send the pricing workbook and SOC2 certs by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Ana Suarez <ana@cloudwave.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWave Procurement <procure@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify deployment cost tradeoffs and commit options

Jonas — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying asks from our side before you build the scenarios:

1) Please give concrete monthly cost estimates for: a) hosted per-token (with a 25M tokens/day baseline and two peak scenarios), and b) a 6-month and 12-month Dedicated reserved capacity commitment (include GPU count assumptions).
2) For VPC/private deployment, list one-time setup costs and the timeline to stand up the control plane in our VPC.
3) Security: we will need SOC2 attestation and a network/topology diagram before infrastructure approval. Providing a short checklist of required firewall rules and CIDR ranges would be helpful.
4) Procurement: we prefer net45 terms and require vendor onboarding forms. Can you include sample invoicing cadence for committed capacity?

Procurement note: please cc our procurement lead (procure@cloudwave.com) on pricing docs so we can start vendor intake.

If you can include a simple comparison table (per-token vs reserved capacity, expected break-even token/day, recommended option for 3–12 month horizon) that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Ana Suarez
Head of Platform Engineering | CloudWave Labs
ana.suarez@cloudwave.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Clarify deployment cost tradeoffs and commit options

Forwarding Ana's note + initial pricing math. I attached the working workbook (redwood-pricing-model.xlsx) and our SOC2 summary (soc2-summary.pdf). Key bullets below — these are preliminary numbers for discussion, not final pricing.

--- forwarded message ---
From: Ana Suarez <ana@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify deployment cost tradeoffs and commit options
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWave Procurement <procure@cloudwave.com>

Jonas — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying asks...

--- end forwarded message ---

Prelim pricing highlights (i.e., quick heuristics):
- Hosted per-token: assume $0.0009 / token for generation tier X with volume discounts kicking at 500M tokens/month; baseline (25M/day) => ~$675K/month list, with sliding discounts we can show lower effective rates in workbook.
- Dedicated reserved (6mo): recommend a small pool: 4xA100-equivalent GPUs; committed monthly cost roughly $220K/month (6mo commit reduces unit cost vs on-demand).
- Dedicated reserved (12mo): similar pool, ~$200K/month with steeper discount and priority capacity.
- Break-even: in our rough model Dedicated becomes favorable above ~18–22M tokens/day depending on model size and KV cache hit rates.
- VPC one-time: $25K onboarding + project engineering for networking + 10 business days for control plane in customer's VPC (assuming standard peering and no on-prem air-gapped work).

Next steps I recommend we present two clean options to CloudWave:
A) Hosted pilot (2 weeks) — quick benchmark, no VPC, per-token billing, token cap TBD.
B) Small Dedicated pilot (2–4 weeks) — short reserved pool, discounted pilot rate, includes VPC onboarding if required.

I attached the workbook; Jonas — can you review and redline the suggested numbers before I send to Ana and procurement?

-Lauren
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Suarez <ana@cloudwave.com>, CloudWave Procurement <procure@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify deployment cost tradeoffs and commit options

Ana / procurement team — attaching the two requested artifacts: redwood-pricing-model.xlsx and soc2-summary.pdf. Summary of options and explicit asks below.

Option 1 — Hosted per-token trial (low-friction)
- Pilot: 2 weeks, token cap 100M, no VPC.
- Estimated cost for pilot (pro forma): $9,000 (credit applied for pilot).
- Production: per-token pricing; example effective price tiers in workbook. Good if you want fastest time-to-eval and no network setup.

Option 2 — Dedicated reserved pilot -> conversion to commit
- Pilot: 2–4 weeks using a 4-GPU pool sized for 400ms p95.
- Pilot rate: reduced flat pilot fee $25,000 (covers reserved capacity + infra).
- 6-month commit example: $220,000/month (preferred), net45 invoicing cadence, priority capacity and a 10% volume discount on top of commit.
- 12-month commit example: $200,000/month, net45, includes SLA credit thresholds and extended support.

VPC / Private notes
- One-time onboarding (control plane + network runbook): $25,000; timeline ~10 business days after account access and vendor setup.
- For private on-prem installs we need a short infra questionnaire — we can share that after you confirm interest.

Security & procurement
- SOC2 summary attached; full report available under NDA (we can start an NDA if procurement prefers).
- Vendor onboarding: we can accept PO and net45 terms. Sample SOW and invoice cadence linked here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/0001493.

Requested next steps (pick one):
- Reply "Hosted pilot" and we’ll provision a hosted trial by EOD Monday and apply the pilot credit.
- Reply "Dedicated pilot" and we’ll schedule a 30-minute sizing call next week to lock GPU profile and calendar the onboarding window.
- If procurement wants the SOW signed first, use DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/REDACTED/SOW-1493.

I’ll stand up a short call with our solutions engineer (Markus) if you want to review the performance targets and live bench numbers.

Thanks,

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
